direction: Canon constrains Plot; Plot directs Prose; Prose realizes accepted manuscript output.
navigation: Workflow is navigable in both directions for diagnosis, but upstream mutation requires explicit treatment at the owning layer.
lowest_layer_rule: Resolve a problem at the lowest workflow layer capable of preserving required meaning; escalate upstream only when necessary.
consequential_change_rule: A consequential fact or structural decision invented downstream remains a proposal until explicitly accepted at its owning Canon or Plot layer.
generation_readiness_rule: Do not generate when unresolved consequential meaning is required to bound the task; refine or surface the decision instead.
